data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 integrates SRC_002's general CRT residue-class result n≡18 mod 35 with SRC_005's exhaustive minimality check: the algebraic derivation (5a+3≡4 mod 7, a≡3 mod 7, x=18) supplies the candidate, and the exhaustive sweep below 18 supplies the floor-complete guarantee that no smaller member of the residue class was missed. This relation is REFUTED IF either the algebraic method alone is self-certifying for minimality (rendering the sweep decorative) or if the two derivations disagree on the answer. The dependence is on SRC_004.
